message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts.

Two separate incidents involving same defendant Li.

First: arson (放火) causing property loss ~50万元. Under Chinese Criminal Law, arson causing serious loss is crime of arson (非法放火罪) maybe "放火罪" (arson). The description: "以放火的方法，危害公共安全，造成公司财产重大损失". So charge: "放火罪". Could also be "非法燃烧、放火罪" but official term is "放火罪". In Chinese criminal law, article 132: "放火罪". So first charge: 放火.

Second: robbery (抢劫) using a knife, threatening driver, taking cash 137 yuan. That's robbery (抢劫罪). The amount is small but still robbery. So second charge: 抢劫.

Thus answer: [罪名]放火;抢劫<eoa>

Check if any other charges: maybe "非法占有" but that's part of robbery. So two charges.
